reviews.title: From a Great Learning Tool to a Paywall
reviews.text:
I’ve been an avid Photomath user for years, and unfortunately, I’m really disappointed with the direction the app has taken. One of the things that originally made Photomath so useful was its ability to quickly help you understand a math problem—not simply give you an answer.

Over time, however, more and more of the genuinely helpful features seem to have been locked behind a subscription. At this point, the free version feels so restricted that the app has lost much of what made it valuable in the first place.

I understand that developers need to make money and that premium features are reasonable. But there’s a difference between offering additional benefits to subscribers and gradually removing or restricting the core functionality that longtime users came to rely on.

I’ve recommended Photomath many times over the years because it was an excellent learning tool. I wish I could still recommend it as enthusiastically. Unfortunately, unless you’re willing to pay for the subscription, it simply isn’t nearly as helpful as it used to be.

reviews.title: Loyal user for YEARS
reviews.text: I’ve been using Photomath for several years. I purchased Photomath plus in seventh, and it genuinely helped me to learn by showing me the steps and how to do problems for textbooks. I haven’t used it in about 4 months, as I hadn’t been taking a math class, and the same text book I already had saved months ago is gone. There is nowhere to access any textbooks. This is the whole reason I pay for Photomath plus, and have been for a while (current sophomore) and I genuinely use almost all my money to renew this subscription every month because of how much it helps me. Now I’m scanning every problem in the book and it either gives me an answer that has no correlation whatsoever to the problem, or it tells me to use Google homework helper, which doesn’t explain it well and has never given me an answer correctly or how to show my work properly. I’m not sure if this is a bug or some new update but either way I’m extremely dissatisfied in what’s going on. A year ago I would’ve given this app 5 stars and now I wish I could give it 0.
